why: The arrows go round the corners: figure 1 starts in the bottom-left corner pointing up-right, figure 2 ends in the top-right corner. Figure 3 must start in the bottom-right corner pointing up-left, so that figure 4 can end in the top-left corner with the same direction. Option 4 is exactly that. Option 2 is just figure 1 again.
trick: If the ? is in the middle, use the figures on BOTH sides of it.
